def.2020.mg: %20/20: share of readings within ±20 mg/dL of the reference below 100 mg/dL, or within ±20% at or above 100 mg/dL.
def.2020.mmol: %20/20: share of readings within ±1.1 mmol/L of the reference below 5.6 mmol/L, or within ±20% at or above 5.6 mmol/L.
mard.note: MARD values come from studies with different designs and reference methods. They are not directly comparable across devices.
h2h.title: Head-to-head studies
h2h.intro: Same participants wearing several sensors at once. The ranking changes with the reference method.

gate.title: For health professionals only
gate.body1: This site compares continuous glucose monitoring systems using published studies and regulator records. It is general information, not advice about any individual patient or device choice.
gate.body2: Figures come from studies with different designs and may not be comparable. Approval, indications and subsidy differ by country and change often. Always check the current product label and local regulator before prescribing.
